name: monthly_saving_needed
description: Works out, for each wedding payment, how much more you would need to save each month to close the shortfall before that payment is due.
formula: For each payment: months = number of monthly saving dates after today and on or before the due date (saving dates fall on the same day of the month as today, one month after another; if a month is too short, use its last day). Extra monthly saving needed = shortfall / months, rounded up to the next cent. If the shortfall is 0, the result is 0. If months is 0 and there is a shortfall, the extra saving needed is the whole shortfall. The shortfall is the amount still missing after counting the monthly saving you already plan, so the result is on top of that saving.

inputs.name: today
inputs.description: Today's date. Months are counted from the day after today.

inputs.name: payments
inputs.description: One item for each wedding payment. Each item has name (text, for example payment 1), due_date (a date) and shortfall (money in your currency still missing after paying, or 0 if the fund covers it). Use the results of the fund balance forecast step.

output.description: One item for each payment, in order of due date. Each item has: name (text), due_date (a date), shortfall (money in your currency), months_until_due (whole number of saving dates before the due date), and extra_monthly_saving_needed (money in your currency per month, on top of the saving already planned; 0 if there is no shortfall).
